key_findings: CB2 and TRPV1 are upregulated in sickle cell disease macrophages, which show an M1-skewed, pro-inflammatory phenotype.
CB2 (JWH-133) and TRPV1 (RTX) stimulation shifted SCD macrophages toward an M2-like phenotype, reduced IL-6 and raised ferroportin.
